protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No published topical concentration; only ex-vivo hair-follicle experiment cited 10 pg/mL and an uncontrolled 18-person case series. Zinc appears as excipient in vendor specs, not a demonstrated zinc-peptide complex. No validated dose.
